title: Build visible layer panel and parallax preview from store
description: The existing layers list and preview are built by imperative DOM code, while the completed layer store is unused. Implement React components for layer list, reorder/delete/visibility/depth/opacity controls, and Framer Motion or equivalent preview from store state.
acceptance_criteria: Layer management controls are visible, update store state, and parallax preview reflects store changes without relying on legacy DOM rendering.

title: Expose SAM selection and mask conversion in the editor
description: src/workers/sam.worker.ts exists but is not referenced by the frontend. Add visible selection controls that send click prompts/image data to the worker, report model loading/errors, convert returned masks into layer masks, and let users confirm selected objects as layers.
acceptance_criteria: User can click/select an object, see loading/error status, preview the mask, and commit the selection as a layer in the visible UI.

title: Replace legacy parallax state with React store wiring
description: Visible parallax frontend still depends on initLegacyApp DOM state in src/legacy.ts. Connect the parallax UI to src/store/useLayerStore.ts so background image, active layer, selection, ordering, visibility, depth, opacity, and preview mode come from the Zustand store.
acceptance_criteria: Parallax controls read/write useLayerStore state, legacy duplicate state is removed or isolated to lenticular only, and store selectors are exercised by visible components.

title: Connect OpenCV inpainting to background cleanup
description: src/utils/inpaint.ts exists but is not referenced by the frontend. Use the selected mask to inpaint the background after object extraction, expose progress/errors, and store the cleaned background for preview/export.
acceptance_criteria: After committing a selected object layer, the background can be cleaned with inpainting, errors surface in the UI, and preview/export use the cleaned background when available.

title: Wire Upload image payload into parallax background
description: src/components/Upload.tsx is rendered, but the genui:parallax-upload listener in src/legacy.ts ignores event.detail.image and reloads the file. Use CanvasReadyImage directly to set the parallax background, dimensions, preview data, and store state. Remove the stale Upload.jsx duplicate unless build tooling requires it.
acceptance_criteria: Uploading once updates the visible parallax stage through the React/store path, no duplicate file decoding is needed, and Upload.jsx is removed or documented if retained.

title: Wire completed parallax work into frontend
description: Audit found worktree-delivered pieces present in src but not connected to the visible React frontend. The app renders Upload, but parallax behavior is still driven by legacy DOM state; Zustand layer store, SAM worker, OpenCV inpaint helper, and export utilities are not imported by any visible UI path. Fix by replacing or wrapping the legacy parallax flow with React components that use these modules.
acceptance_criteria: A user can upload an image, create/select object layers through the React UI, see SAM/model and inpaint status, manage layers via Zustand-backed controls, preview parallax, and export using the shared export utilities. Unused duplicate Upload.jsx is removed or justified.

title: Implement Framer Motion parallax preview
description: Create ParallaxPreview.jsx using useMotionValue and useTransform so mouse movement drives each layer by depth multiplier. Scale layers to 110 percent to hide edges.
acceptance_criteria: Preview mode hides editing sidebars, tracks desktop mouse movement, and animates layers smoothly with foreground moving more than background.

title: Commit confirmed selection as layer
description: Wire confirm action to extract selected object as a new independent layer, inpaint the background hole, reset selection state, and keep Layer 0 as base.
acceptance_criteria: Each confirmed selection creates a new visible layer with default depth; background updates to inpainted base; max 5 layer recommendation is enforced or warned.

title: Implement OpenCV.js inpainting helper
description: Create inpaint.js to load/use window.cv from https://docs.opencv.org/4.8.0/opencv.js and apply Telea inpainting only to selected mask region.
acceptance_criteria: Confirmed mask produces inpainted background ImageData using cv.inpaint with cv.INPAINT_TELEA; OpenCV load errors are surfaced.
close_reason: Implemented OpenCV.js Telea inpainting helper with loader errors surfaced and mask-only region conversion.

title: Build selection click overlay
description: Create ClickOverlay.jsx to capture left-click positive points and right-click negative points, normalize coordinates to 0-1, call SAM worker, and display mask previews.
acceptance_criteria: Positive and negative clicks refine selection; context menu is suppressed over canvas; confirm/cancel actions are available.

title: Implement mask conversion utilities
description: Create maskToImageData.js to convert SAM masks into colored transparent overlays and cutout alpha masks for layer extraction.
acceptance_criteria: Mask overlay renders at canvas scale; selected object can be extracted as transparent PNG/image data.

title: Implement SAM Web Worker inference
description: Create src/workers/sam.worker.js using @huggingface/transformers pipeline for image-segmentation with Xenova/sam-vit-base or Xenova/samseg. Load once, cache in worker, process click prompts off main thread.
acceptance_criteria: Main thread sends imageData and normalized clicks; worker returns mask Uint8Array with width and height; UI stays responsive during inference.
close_reason: Implemented SAM worker inference with cached in-browser model, normalized click prompts, and transferable mask responses.

title: Build Konva editing canvas
description: Create Canvas.jsx using react-konva to render background, object layers, and mask overlay in edit mode.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas renders uploaded photo and layers at correct aspect ratio; supports selection overlay without layout shift.

title: Build image upload flow
description: Create Upload.jsx with drag-and-drop and click-to-upload support. Load selected image into canvas-ready browser image data.
acceptance_criteria: User can drag/drop or choose a photo; app displays it; large images are constrained to 1024px max dimension.
close_reason: Implemented Upload.jsx drag/drop and click upload with 1024px canvas-ready image resizing.

title: Implement Zustand layer store
description: Create src/store/useLayerStore.js for background layer, object layers, masks, depth values, visibility, names, ordering, current mode, and selection state.
acceptance_criteria: Store supports add, rename, delete, hide/show, reorder, depth update, mode toggle, and active selection updates.
close_reason: Closed

title: Scaffold React Vite app and dependencies
description: Set up React + Vite project with Tailwind CSS, Zustand, react-konva, Framer Motion, @huggingface/transformers, and export helper dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: App boots locally; dependencies installed; src structure matches requested components, workers, store, and utils folders.
close_reason: Scaffolded React Vite app, dependencies, source folders, worker/store/utils; npm build passes.

title: Build browser-only parallax photo effects app
description: Create a React + Vite web app for turning one uploaded photo into layered parallax animation. Runs entirely in browser with no backend and no API keys.
acceptance_criteria: User can upload a photo, segment objects with in-browser SAM, inpaint background holes, manage layers, preview mouse-driven parallax, and export WebP/MP4/PNG ZIP.

title: Improve parallax smart object snap
description: Refine parallax draw selection so highlighted objects snap to their visible frame and isolate from the background for hover and scroll parallax.
close_reason: Improved smart draw selection with edge-aware object snap and masked isolation for parallax.

title: Use export utilities for parallax outputs
description: src/utils/export.ts is not imported by visible frontend code. Replace the legacy textarea-only export path with shared export utilities for PNG/asset packaging where appropriate, while preserving copyable embed output.
acceptance_criteria: Visible export buttons call shared export utilities, generated outputs include current layers/background, and copyable embed output still works.

title: Verify completed worktree features are visible in browser
description: Add a verification pass for the integration epic. Check that upload, store-backed layers, SAM status, mask/inpaint flow, preview, and exports are reachable from the running frontend. Document or remove any remaining unused modules.
acceptance_criteria: Build passes, browser smoke test confirms each previously unused module has a visible workflow, and rg/import audit shows no accidental dead duplicate files.

title: Verify browser-only parallax workflow

acceptance_criteria: Build passes; smoke test notes cover supported browser behavior and known limitations for no-backend/no-API-key operation.

title: Apply browser performance safeguards
description: Keep SAM inference in worker, constrain canvas to 1024px max dimension, avoid unnecessary mask/inpaint work, and document 5-layer performance recommendation in UI behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Large images are downscaled; worker lifecycle is cleaned up; inference and inpainting show busy state; app remains responsive.

title: Build responsive app layout and status bar
description: Implement app shell with top bar, center canvas, left layer panel, right selection tools, bottom status bar, and full-screen preview layout.
acceptance_criteria: Edit mode shows panels and status; preview mode uses full available canvas; no overlapping UI at desktop target sizes.

title: Implement export utilities

acceptance_criteria: User can download animated WebP, MP4 when browser supports MediaRecorder, and ZIP containing each layer PNG.

title: Build toolbar and mode controls

acceptance_criteria: Top bar switches modes, exposes export actions, and keeps selection actions visible only when relevant.

title: Build layer management panel

acceptance_criteria: Layer panel operations update store and canvas immediately; background remains Layer 0 and cannot be deleted.

title: Add SAM model loading status UI
